entities.summary: The Gendarmerie Intelligence Organization or the Gendarmerie Intelligence and Counter-Terrorism is the intelligence department of the Turkish Gendarmerie. JİTEM was active in the Kurdish–Turkish conflict. After the Susurluk scandal, former prime ministers Bülent Ecevit and Mesut Yılmaz have confirmed the existence of JİTEM.
